subject: Is there a way to sync ui.r and server.r files between github and shiny server?

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Is there a way to sync ui.r and server.r files between github and shiny server?
parts:
It would be nice to be able to edit ui.r and server.r files locally, push to github, then files automatically synced to the shiny server. Is this possible? Or do ui.r and server.r files have to be in the server itself?

Thanks! Scott

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to sync ui.r and server.r files between github and shiny server?
parts:
You can directly sync the local version of your app with the shiny server glimmer using rsync.

rsync -avz --delete <local-repo> <username>@glimmer.rstudio.com:~/ShinyApps/

You can create a makefile to automate pushing source code to github and application to glimmer.

deploy:
   git push g...@github.com:<username>/<repo>
   rsync -avz --delete <local-repo> <username>@glimmer.rstudio.com:~/ShinyApps/ 

Hope this helps.

Best,
Ramnath

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to sync ui.r and server.r files between github and shiny server?
parts:
Here is the idea. You create a makefile in the root directory of your application on your local machine with the following code. Make sure to substitute username, repo and local-repo (which will most likely be the current directory if you are already inside your app).

If you now run make deploy in the command line, it will both push your repo to github AND to glimmer.

deploy:
   git push g...@github.com:<username>/<repo>
   rsync -avz --delete <local-repo> <username>@glimmer.rstudio.com:~/ShinyApps/
